ὑφαίνεσκον: ὑφαίνω — weave; impf. iterative 1 sg. (also 3 pl.), -σκ-: ’I used to weave’

__broaden__.αὐτοῖς: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. pl., intensive with σφίσι: ’for themselves’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. dat. pl.: αὐτοῖς ὀβελοῖσιν ’the very spits’ · also plain dat. pl. pronoun, unemphatic: ’to them’ (αὐτοῖς μετέειπον ’spoke among them’)
__broaden__.καρπῷ: καρπός — wrist; masc. dat. sg. (distinct from καρπός ’fruit’) · also καρπός — fruit, produce; masc. dat. sg., dat. of cause or respect: ’with fruit’ (βρίθῃσι δένδρεα καρπῷ ’the trees are laden with fruit’)
__broaden__.κύνας: κύων — dog; masc./fem. acc. pl. (of sea creatures, perhaps dogfish) · also fem. acc. pl. as a term of abuse for shameless women: ’shameless creatures, bitches’ (of maidservants)
__broaden__.θυμόν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (μελέων ἐξείλετο θυμόν ’took the life out of the limbs’) · also the seat of appetite: ’appetite’ (πλησαίατο θυμόν ’might satisfy their appetite’)
__broaden__.μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’) · also with the optative, a negative wish: ’may … not’ (μή … ἀντιβολήσαις) · also ὡς ἂν μή + subj., negative purpose: ’so that … not’ (ὡς ἂν μή σε κατατρύχῃ ’so that he may not wear you out’) · also + subj. giving the content of an oath, ’that no one …’ (ὀμόσσατε … μή τις … πλήξῃ ’swear that no one strike’) · also μή + subj. standing alone as a warning, ’lest’ (μή τίς τοι … ἀναστῇ ’lest someone rise up against you’) · also μή + fut. indic. in a fear clause: ’lest, I fear’ (μή τίς … νεμεσήσεται ’lest anyone resent’)
__broaden__.οἷός: οἷος — such as, of what sort; relative adj., masc. nom. sg., correlative with τοῖος: ’such as, as ... when’ · also οἷός τε + inf., ’able to, fit to’ (οἷός τε … κήδεσθαι ’such as to care for, able to care for’)
__broaden__.παραθείμην: παρατίθημι — set beside, set before; aor. opt. mid. 1 sg., potential after κε: ’I would set before’ · also opt. in a past general clause after ἐπεί, without κε: ’whenever I had set (torches) beside’
__broaden__.πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’) · also neut. nom. pl., attributive: ’many’ (ἤματα πόλλ’ ’many days’)
__broaden__.τόσσον: τόσος (epic τόσσος) — so much, so great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’so much’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον, acc. of duration: ’so long’ (τόσσον χρόνον ’so long a time’)
__broaden__.ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, correlative with τόσσον: ’as far as’ · also in an indirect exclamation, ’how greatly’ (ὅσσον ἄρισται ’how excellent they are’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν, in an indirect exclamation: ’how great (a host)’ · also acc. of duration, correlative with τόσσον: ’as long as’ (τόσσον χρόνον ὅσσον ’so long a time as’)
__broaden__.εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’ · also in the idiom εἰς ὅτε (κε) + subj., ’until the time when’ (εἰς ὅτε κέν … καθέλῃσι ’until … brings down’)
__broaden__.ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’) · also fem. nom. sg. distributive: ’one … another’ (ἄλλη δ’ ἄλλων γλῶσσα ’each tongue differing from the others’)
__broaden__.ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’)
__broaden__.ἱέμενον: ἵεμαι — long for, be eager; pres. part. mid., masc. acc. sg., + gen.: ’(you) eager for (your return)’ · ἵεμαι — hasten, make for; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg.: ’making for (Troy)’
